michele.name: Michele
michele.intro: One of P.U.S' new investigators. Dedicated to safeguarding "Utopia."
michele.quote: Stay sharp, the game's not over yet!

weapon.name: Inspector
weapon.desc: Designed for dominating the battlefield, this assault rifle offers a great balance of accuracy and rate of fire. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Feline Lock
awakenings.desc: Pawtectors' attacks make enemies continuously visible.

awakenings.name: Paw Protector
awakenings.desc: Gain bonus Max Armor while at least one Pawtector is active. When an active Pawtector is destroyed, gain Temporary Armor.

awakenings.name: Whisker Bond
awakenings.desc: Increase your Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability when within 15m of a Pawtector.

xin.name: Nobunaga
xin.intro: A P.U.S captain. He has vowed to protect all of Strinova.
xin.quote: Justice needs no explanation, only action.

weapon.name: Judge
weapon.desc: This automatic rifle uses high-powered rounds for superior combat effectiveness, perfect for all-weather operations. Equipped with a 1.5x scope and switchable between semi-automatic and automatic modes.

items.text: Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability +50%

awakenings.name: Last Stand
awakenings.desc: Inside the device range, survive one fatal hit and recover some HP and armor.

awakenings.name: Eye of Justice
awakenings.desc: Enemies entering the device's range are continuously revealed.

awakenings.name: Warp Link
awakenings.desc: You can teleport between devices.

xinxia.name: Kokona
xinxia.intro: One of P.U.S' main operators, and a traveler exploring the very reaches of the world.
xinxia.quote: Life's greatest satisfactions? Clocking out on time and never missing a meal.

weapon.name: Quasar
weapon.desc: This tactical intervention sniper rifle perfectly combines precision, power, and stealth. Once the longest-range model among Earth's sniper rifles. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

awakenings.name: Rejuvenation
awakenings.desc: When the Drone begins healing an ally, it instantly restores a large amount of HP.

awakenings.name: Armor Surge
awakenings.desc: The Drone restores Armor to all nearby allies.

awakenings.name: Guardian
awakenings.desc: The Drone shields its healing target by absorbing incoming DMG.

yvette.name: Yvette
yvette.intro: A P.U.S researcher. Best friends with a stuffed bear.
yvette.quote: Sorry, I'm just not very good at speaking up, it's not that I don't like you...

weapon.name: Beareas
weapon.desc: A light-weight submachine gun with an unusually high rate of fire and precision compared to most other weapons in its class. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Ice Burst
awakenings.desc: Fay explodes upon disappearing, slowing nearby enemies and leaving an icy surface.

awakenings.name: Snowball Fight
awakenings.desc: Fay now throws snowballs that create ice and damage enemies on impact.

awakenings.name: Sentinel Teddy
awakenings.desc: When uncontrolled, Fay detects enemies in range and forms ice on the spot.

flavia.name: Flavia
flavia.intro: An aggressive and calculating squad leader.
flavia.quote: If you can't handle this gentle questioning, who knows what might happen next?

weapon.name: Solo
weapon.desc: A light-weight submachine gun with an unusually high rate of fire and precision compared to most other weapons in its class. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Fantasy Rebirth
awakenings.desc: After summoning a Phantom Orb, you regenerate HP over time.

awakenings.name: Butterfly Veil
awakenings.desc: Modifies the Active Skill to immediately grant invincibility for a short period, summoning a Phantom Orb at your location.

awakenings.name: Butterfly Armor
awakenings.desc: Turn invisible while in the Active Skill's invincible state. Gain Temporary Armor after leaving the invincible state.

youwu.name: Yugiri
youwu.intro: A girl with a tragic past and a troubled fate, under the supervision and care of P.U.S.
youwu.quote: It costs a lot to send me on assignments.

weapon.name: Retribution
weapon.desc: The standout bullpup rifle, known for its exceptional all-around performance. A classic from old Earth firearms. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Contamination
awakenings.desc: Enemies within the Active Skill's toxic mist have reduced Movement Speed.

awakenings.name: Toxic Expansion
awakenings.desc: Upon activation, the spherical mist gradually expands over time.

awakenings.name: Toxic Cloak
awakenings.desc: The mist turns opaque, blocking vision. Receive an alert when enemies enter the mist. Allies inside the mist continuously restore Armor, and the effect persists even while taking DMG.

leona.name: Leona
leona.intro: The head of P.U.S Engineering, highly meticulous and trustworthy.
leona.quote: I've fixed the last 0.2mm error, and the blueprint is complete! Wait, it's already 3 a.m.?

weapon.name: Calibrator
weapon.desc: Known for its remarkable power and performance, this general-purpose machine gun was a classic sweeper weapon from old Earth's large-scale wars. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Energy Dispersion
awakenings.desc: Allies near blocks slowly regenerate Armor and briefly gain Movement Speed when moving away from them.

awakenings.name: Fortified Connection
awakenings.desc: Connected blocks are treated as a single unit with shared HP.

awakenings.name: Prism Blast
awakenings.desc: When blocks are destroyed, they explode, damaging and briefly knocking nearby enemies airborne. This DMG also affects other blocks.

chiyo.name: Chiyo
chiyo.intro: A graceful heiress with a charming smile and a fierce archer with decisive skill.
chiyo.quote: I'm nothing special, just an ordinary girl.

weapon.name: Maple Resonance
weapon.desc: This automatic rifle uses high-powered rounds for superior combat effectiveness, perfect for all-weather operations. Equipped with a 1.5x scope.

awakenings.name: Withering Pulse
awakenings.desc: Deal enough DMG with your primary weapon and skills to temporarily weaken the target's Armor and healing effects.

awakenings.name: Splinter Bloom
awakenings.desc: Active Skill explodes, splitting into multiple energy fragments that detonate after a delay.

awakenings.name: Blossoming Bait
awakenings.desc: Active Skill now has reduced CD, reduced DMG, increased base stacks, and significantly extended duration. It can be used during the Preparation Phase, revealing and slowing all targets upon hit.

ming.name: Ming
ming.intro: A member of The Scissors and a rebel opposing P.U.S.
ming.quote: Got a problem? Let our fists do the talking.

weapon.name: Rebelflame
weapon.desc: This high-performance, weather-resistant assault rifle delivers powerful firepower and unbeatable value. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Cyclic Rally
awakenings.desc: Losing all Armor briefly boosts Movement Speed. Re-triggering refreshes the duration.

awakenings.name: Static Siphon
awakenings.desc: Initial Sunder Blast hits grant Temporary Armor.

awakenings.name: Volt Charger
awakenings.desc: Charge up while moving or in Electro Field. At full charge, your next hit slows enemies and regenerates your Armor without DMG interruption.

lawi.name: Lawine
lawi.intro: A member of The Scissors, a blade cutting through deceit.
lawi.quote: Someone must uncover the world's truth and harshness.

weapon.name: Shadow Assault
weapon.desc: Short assault rifle with high stability and outstanding accuracy. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Charged Pulse
awakenings.desc: When the Pulse Blade reveals an enemy, it restores your Armor and briefly increases your Armor cap.

awakenings.name: Binding Pulse
awakenings.desc: When the Pulse Wave hits an enemy, it generates an electromagnetic chain and applies a slow effect. The effect persists briefly after the chain disappears.

awakenings.name: Pulse Echo
awakenings.desc: Enemies revealed by the Pulse Blade are scanned again shortly after being revealed. If they are moving, they are briefly revealed again.

meridith.name: Meredith
meridith.intro: The leader of The Scissors and a scientist pursuing the future of humanity.
meridith.quote: Go have fun, I still need to solve the results of the last experiment that defy the Planck constant.

weapon.name: Falcon
weapon.desc: The standout bullpup assault rifle, known for its exceptional all-around performance. A classic from old Earth firearms. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Whirlwind
awakenings.desc: Allies gliding within the sandstorm are lifted upward by a powerful gust.

awakenings.name: Protective Sandstorm
awakenings.desc: Allies within a Sandstorm gain increased Movement Speed and DMG Reduction. These effects are enhanced while Stringified.

awakenings.name: Desert Veil
awakenings.desc: Enemies within the Sandstorm have their field of view greatly reduced.

ling.name: Reiichi
ling.intro: A member of The Scissors. Bathed in darkness, reaching for the light.
ling.quote: If I can lift up the light, I don't mind being the shadow.

weapon.name: Dawn
weapon.desc: This stable and durable marksman rifle offers excellent control. Its specially weighted rounds enhance long-range accuracy. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

awakenings.name: Sentry Screen
awakenings.desc: Enemies crossing the Light Screen are temporarily exposed.

awakenings.name: Light's Judgment
awakenings.desc: Enemies crossing the Light Screen temporarily lose Max Armor. Allies crossing gain Temporary Armor, triggering once in a short period.

awakenings.name: Chosen Ones
awakenings.desc: The Light Screen turns semi-transparent for nearby allies while remaining opaque to enemies.

kanami.name: Kanami
kanami.intro: Beloved idol singing the songs of joy.
kanami.quote: Take a guess—is my next song about "heartbeat" or "miracle"?

weapon.name: Finale
weapon.desc: Utilizing a short-recoil barrel system, the anti-material sniper rifle delivers astounding power. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

awakenings.name: Sonic Blast
awakenings.desc: Enemies within the Sonar Zone created by weapon fire are temporarily slowed, suffer reduced Weapon Usability, and are revealed to all allies.

awakenings.name: Echo Shock
awakenings.desc: Enemies detected by the Sonar Disk get stunned and have reduced Rate of Fire if they remain in range.

awakenings.name: Melodic Boost
awakenings.desc: Allies within the Sonar Disk's range gain increased Movement Speed, Weapon Usability, and Rate of Fire.

aika.name: Eika
aika.intro: An energetic high school student. Adorned in a mask, she protects her home with the power of fire.
aika.quote: Ever imagine a gun in a violin case? That'd be so cool!

weapon.name: Wildfire
weapon.desc: Fully automatic combat shotgun. There's nothing quite like it.

awakenings.name: Pyro Strings
awakenings.desc: Enemies stringified within the Flame Cage take Burn DMG.

awakenings.name: Encroaching Cage
awakenings.desc: During Active Skill, the cage radius shrinks until it reaches the minimum size.

awakenings.name: Flame of Life
awakenings.desc: As Heat decreases, it converts to a proportion of HP recovery.

fagrans.name: Fragrans
fagrans.intro: A floral expert and master perfumer, she is gentle, charming, and meticulous in life.
fagrans.quote: A scent? Sorry, I was too close. It's... floral.

weapon.name: Blossom
weapon.desc: Relentless firepower to dominate the battlefield, offering an excellent balance of accuracy and firing rate. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Rejuvenate
awakenings.desc: Activating the skill instantly grants nearby allies continuous healing.

awakenings.name: Composite Aroma
awakenings.desc: Activating the skill grants nearby allies a Movement Speed and Rate of Fire bonus, but with reduced duration.

awakenings.name: Eternal Fragrance
awakenings.desc: The Active Skill effect now persists at a lower level after weakening. Switching perfume type changes the ongoing effect.

mala.name: Mara
mala.intro: The sole survivor of the Outbreak incident, she lost dear companions and uncovered secrets that profoundly changed her personality.

weapon.name: Night Scythe
weapon.desc: Mara's signature weapon. A streak of crimson at the end of the barrel resembles the scythe of the Grim Reaper, a harbinger of imminent death.

awakenings.name: Gravity-Bound Soul
awakenings.desc: Enemies bound by the Active Skill have reduced jump speed and height.

awakenings.name: Soul Devourer
awakenings.desc: Hitting enemies with the Active Skill or participating in a kill absorbs their souls, increasing your Movement Speed, Fire Rate, and Weapon Usability. Enemies bound by the Active Skill have their minimap temporarily obscured.

awakenings.name: Soul Form
awakenings.desc: A portion of DMG taken is dealt over time instead. Participating in a knockdown prevents the remaining DMG from being dealt over time. Slowly recover HP after leaving combat.

nono.name: Nora
nono.intro: A specially recruited member of The Scissors, carrying the burden of her family's legacy and pursuing a path toward light.
nono.quote: No matter which path I choose, it is always my own decision.

weapon.name: Rainveil
weapon.desc: A next-generation submachine gun designed for personal defense. Its overwhelming firepower and high operational cost have earned it the nickname "cash sprinkler."

awakenings.name: Dark String Echo
awakenings.desc: When spirits summoned by the Active Skill are destroyed or disappear, they leave behind residual Dark String energy. Collecting it reduces the cooldown of both Active and Passive Skills.

awakenings.name: Residual String Embers
awakenings.desc: Dark String Missiles fired by spirits detonate and create an erosion field that continuously damages and slows enemies inside it.

awakenings.name: Eye of Omniscience
awakenings.desc: Greatly extend the duration of summoned spirits. While they are active, the Active Skill can be reactivated to take direct control of a spirit, enhancing its attributes during the control period.

audrey.name: Audrey
audrey.intro: An Urbino merchant of some renown and the head of the Grove family.
audrey.quote: Without a doubt, I’m your top choice for a formidable ally.

weapon.name: Champion
weapon.desc: Known for its remarkable power and performance, this general-purpose machine gun was a classic sweeper weapon from old Earth's large-scale wars. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Field Mobility
awakenings.desc: Allows lateral movement in Deployment Mode.

awakenings.name: Auto Turret
awakenings.desc: While in Deployment Mode, press and hold the Active Skill button to deploy an Autoturret. If the turret is destroyed, it enters a cooldown and cannot be redeployed for a set period.

awakenings.name: Onslaught
awakenings.desc: Rate of Fire gradually increases with continuous shooting. Primary Weapon no longer needs to Reload, but continuous shooting can cause Overheat.

madeleine.name: Maddelena
madeleine.intro: A sunny and cheerful artist who always seems to end up in the middle of one trouble or another.
madeleine.quote: Time to head out! I wonder what new adventures await today?

weapon.name: Chroma
weapon.desc: Balancing power and range perfectly, the marksman rifle excels at suppressing mid-to-long-distance targets. Comes equipped with a 1.5x scope.

awakenings.name: Wall Whisper
awakenings.desc: Teammates wall-sticking in painted areas will conceal themselves, greatly boost Movement Speed, and slowly heal.

awakenings.name: Painter's Trail
awakenings.desc: Fires paint that forms a trailing line, creating additional paint zones.

awakenings.name: Dyeblast
awakenings.desc: A bubble forms in the painted area to block vision; it explodes on contact, applying a paint debuff to enemies.

freesia.name: Fuchsia
freesia.intro: The honed blade of Urbino, and a hardened killer seeking for a home.
freesia.quote: Don't call me in the morning. Waking up on the wrong side makes me dangerous.

weapon.name: Sawtooth
weapon.desc: Balancing power and stability, this battle rifle is a fine example of Earth's industrial craftsmanship. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Gluttony
awakenings.desc: Crystal absorption range extends to the entire map.

awakenings.name: Second Wind
awakenings.desc: While knocked down, Max HP is increased, and you will automatically recover after a short duration.

awakenings.name: Terror Hunter
awakenings.desc: Active skill briefly slows enemies in range.

xinghui.name: Celestia
xinghui.intro: The founder of the Astral Sanctuary. A gentle girl dedicated to building a peaceful world.
xinghui.quote: Make sure to drop by Astral Sanctuary for a quick check-up.

weapon.name: Polaris
weapon.desc: Built for sustained use with excellent heat dissipation, this assault rifle provides precise accuracy for close-range shots, with a smooth trigger pull and ambidextrous comfort. Equipped with a 1.25x scope and switchable between automatic and burst modes.

awakenings.name: Comet Bracers
awakenings.desc: Active Skill gains Temporary Armor regeneration, immune to DMG interruptions.

awakenings.name: Starlight
awakenings.desc: When the Armor from the Active Skill is breached, it releases starlight that blinds enemies.

awakenings.name: Astral Armor
awakenings.desc: Active Skill instantly restores some Armor.

baimo.name: Bai Mo
baimo.intro: Though now a high-up of Urbino, there's nothing this street youth values more than freedom.
baimo.quote: Even the biggest crisis can wait until the party's over!

weapon.name: Freedom Reign
weapon.desc: A highly reliable and durable semi-automatic featuring ghost ring iron sights for improved accuracy. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Tempo Shift
awakenings.desc: After using an Active Skill, Armor gradually restores without interruption from taking DMG.

awakenings.name: Ink Charge
awakenings.desc: Using the Active Skill grants extra DMG reduction and splashes paint at the landing point, briefly obscuring nearby enemies' vision.

awakenings.name: Trickster
awakenings.desc: Briefly enter stealth during Active Skill, leaving a decoy at the starting point.

galatea.name: Galatea
galatea.intro: A renowned magician and a mad artist hiding behind her glamor.
galatea.quote: This is boring. What should we do next?

weapon.name: Gambit
weapon.desc: This high-performance, weather-resistant assault rifle delivers powerful firepower and unbeatable value. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Illusionary Strike
awakenings.desc: Gain Temporary Armor and briefly boost Weapon Usability upon teleporting.

awakenings.name: Snap
awakenings.desc: Teleport to trigger 3 seconds of stealth, increasing Movement Speed and holstering your weapon.

awakenings.name: Castling
awakenings.desc: Leave a decoy at your original location after teleporting.

xi.name: Cielle
xi.intro: A girl with lost memories, currently a Bounty Hunter settled in Urbino.
xi.quote: Relax, boss—if the pay's real, so is my loyalty.

weapon.name: Surfbreak
weapon.desc: Lever-action shotgun with high reliability and durability. Deals massive damage at close range. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

awakenings.name: Momentum Surge
awakenings.desc: Gain a brief Movement Speed boost after a charge, manual shield detonation, or using a Tactical Skill.

awakenings.name: Bulwark Buster
awakenings.desc: While holding the shield, hold right-click to detonate it, dealing DMG to enemies in front. Grants Temporary Armor and restores part of the shield's CD.

awakenings.name: Unified Guard
awakenings.desc: While the shield is raised, all incoming DMG is absorbed by the shield, with extra DMG applied to it.
